<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 10:15">Ib. X, 15</cite> <he>זְכִיתִי</he> (some ed. <he>זִכִּי׳</he>, corr. acc.); a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 25:29">Targ. Jer. XXV, 29</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to deserve welt, do good, to obtain a claim on divine favor.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:14">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> [read:] <he>אדם … זְכִי בי או דְכִי בי</he> the beggar says … ‘obtain a claim &c. through me’, or ‘become pure through me’, (which means) <he>זַכֵּי גרמך בי</he> benefit thyself through me.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:14">Ib.</cite> <he>אנן זַכְיִין בך</he> we shall give thee something.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:14">Ib.</cite> <he>ז׳ בהאי אתתא</he> give this woman (me) something.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:7:6">Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שלח … מִזְכֵּי וכ׳</he> sent his son to Tiberias for his improvement (through study); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:7:6">Y. Pes. III, 30ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>יזכי</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to become worthy of divine grace, to be privileged to enjoy, to live to see.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 20:17">Targ. Job XX, 17</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:14">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>נשים במאי זַכְיָין</he> wherewith do women (who do not study the Law) deserve divine grace?—
<cite ref="Shabbat 21b:2">Sabb. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>אי זְכָאִי</he> if I had been worthy (if the Lord had permitted me).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:8">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>אי זָכִית אכלית</he> if the Lord permit, I may eat thereof.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:8">Ib.</cite> <he>אם זַכְיַת</he> (<he>תיכול</he>) <he>אכול</he> if thou shalt live long enough to eat thereof.
Ḥull. 50ᵃ; Bets. 27ᵃ, a. e. אִזְכֵּי ואסיק וכ׳ the Lord permitting I will go &c.; a. fr.—4) to take possession, acquire a title.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 8a:6">B. Mets. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>מיגו דזָכֵי לנפשיה</he> since he has a right to take possession for himself, v. <cite ref="M01085"><he>מִיגּוֹ</he></cite>, s. v. <cite ref="C00263"><he>גּוֹ</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 12b:11">B. Kam. 12ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10b:7">M. Kat. 10ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 54a">B. Bath. 54ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00351"><he>זִיכֵּי</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to clear, acquit, justify; to leave unpunished.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 20:7">Targ. O. Ex. XX, 7</cite> (Y. <he>מִזְכֵי</he>, read: <he>מְזַכֵּי</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:3">Targ. Cant. VII, 3</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 73:13">Targ. Ps. LXXIII, 13</cite> <he>זַכָּאִית</he> Ms. (ed. <he>זַכִּית</he>, ed. Wil. <cite ref="G00452"><he>זַכְוַת</he></cite>, corr. acc.); a. e.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:14">Lev. R. s. 34</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:10">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>כל דז׳ מלכא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>למלכא</he>) whosoever defeats the king in argument.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:8">Ib. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>עבדא ז׳ למריה</he> (old ed. <cite ref="K01010"><he>כפייה</he></cite>) the servant conquered his master.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 8b:11">Bekh. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>אי זַכִּיתוּ לי</he> if you defeat me; <he>ואי זַכִּינָא בכו</he> (read <he>לכו</he>) and if we defeat you.
<cite ref="Chullin 31b:19">Ḥull. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>זַכַּנְהוּ וכ׳</he> R. N. defeated the Rabbis; a. e.
<cite ref="Pesachim 78a:14">Pes. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>שטרא מְזַכֵּי לבי תרי</he> a document giving a title to both contestants, i.e. one agreeing with two opposite opinions.

senses.gloss: to be cleared, to go unpunished; to clear one’s self, to defend one’s self.
